title: Kensiu language - Wikipedia
text: Kensiu (Kensiw) is an Austroasiatic language of the Jahaic (Northern Aslian) subbranch. It is spoken by a small community of 300 people in Yala Province in southern Thailand and also reportedly by a community of approximately 300 speakers in Western Malaysia in Perak and Kedah states.

title: Kensiu language
text: Kensiu is an Austroasiatic language belonging to the Northern Aslian (Jahaic) subbranch, spoken natively by the Kensiu people, a Negrito ethnic group of hunter-gatherer descent indigenous to the Thai-Malaysian borderlands.
